name: kbcode Browser Automation
description: kbcode browser automation: navigate, click, type, scrape and screenshot via Chrome extension.
_permissions_note: Audit 2026-07-26 V13: 'management' was REMOVED in 1.7.5 (it could disable any other extension; reload_self now uses chrome.runtime.reload, which needs no permission). webRequest+downloads added 2026-09-01 (P1-4/P1-5): bounded network/download monitoring. webRequestAuthProvider added 2026-09-11: MV3 forbids 'webRequestBlocking' for non-policy extensions, and this is the sanctioned permission for a blocking webRequest.onAuthRequired listener. Without it a 401/407 with no cached credentials raises Chrome's OWN credential modal, which suspends the page's JS thread so every executeScript stops settling and the command dies at kbcode's timeout ('the extension did not answer'). Suppression is gated on agentBusy, so the user's own browsing keeps its real credential prompts. Every permission backs a live tool.
